title: Paid time off policy
text: Full-time employees at Meridian Robotics accrue 20 days of paid time off per year. PTO accrues monthly and unused days roll over up to a maximum of 10 days into the next calendar year. Any balance above 10 days on December 31 is forfeited. PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance through the HR portal.

title: Remote work policy
text: Meridian Robotics operates on a hybrid model. Employees are expected in the office on Tuesday and Wednesday. The remaining three days may be worked remotely. Fully remote arrangements require director-level approval and are reviewed every six months.

title: Parental leave
text: Meridian Robotics offers 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all new parents, regardless of gender. Leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption. An additional 4 weeks of unpaid leave may be requested.

title: Atlas-7 arm specifications
text: The Atlas-7 robotic arm has a payload capacity of 12 kg and a reach of 1.3 meters. It has 6 degrees of freedom and a repeatability of plus or minus 0.02 mm. Rated power draw is 350 watts. The arm ships with a 2-year warranty.

title: Atlas-7 power and battery
text: The Atlas-7 runs on wall power by default. An optional battery pack provides up to 4 hours of continuous operation at rated load. The battery takes 90 minutes to charge from empty to full. The battery pack is sold separately for 1,200 dollars.

title: Titan-3 mobile base specifications
text: The Titan-3 mobile base carries up to 80 kg and moves at a top speed of 1.8 meters per second. It navigates using lidar and has an 8-hour battery life. The Titan-3 is compatible with the Atlas-7 arm through the standard mounting plate.

title: Warranty and returns
text: All Meridian Robotics hardware carries a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the product is in original condition. Warranty claims are filed through the support portal and are typically processed within 5 business days.

title: Firmware updates
text: Firmware for the Atlas-7 and Titan-3 is updated over the air. Updates are released quarterly. Customers on the enterprise support tier receive updates two weeks before general release and can roll back to the previous version within 14 days.

title: Safety certification
text: Meridian Robotics arms are certified to ISO 10218-1 for industrial robots. The Atlas-7 includes a collaborative mode that limits force to 80 newtons, allowing operation near humans without a safety cage when configured correctly.

title: Control API
text: Both the Atlas-7 and Titan-3 expose a REST control API and a Python SDK. The Python SDK requires Python 3.10 or newer. Rate limits on the REST API are 100 requests per second per device. API keys are issued per organization from the developer console.
